notes: v0.1 established 10-minute cloud autonomy but only 5 unique tiles and zero map transitions, so it is retained as the local-motion baseline rather than promoted.
v0.2 route gate is intentionally 3 minutes to test event-targeted BFS and frontier expansion before spending a 3-hour run.
The workflow must use the standard public-repository ubuntu-latest runner, never a paid larger runner.
No external LLM/API is required; all game actions are real Playwright keyboard input while planning reads RPG Maker MV runtime state.
Duration alone is not gameplay verification. Promotion requires route progress, ideally a map transition or battle completion.
